name: reaction_current_behavior
description: A reaction (stanza type 'reaction', ReactionMessage) to a text in a group: the text is a normal inbound line and notice; the reaction is recorded as a 'reaction' line (no text) but is not pending/unhandled and adds nothing to the notice. Before 2026-10-19 the reaction was an empty-text line that counted toward the notice (count 2).

steps.note: empty inbox: claim offset 0, so later lines count as unhandled
the reaction counts toward the notice like the text (2026-10-25)
